# CA-01/CA-02 fixtures

These responses are synthetic contract fixtures using the metric field names in
research/CREATIVE-ANALYTICS-SPEC.md and the existing repository reporting adapters.
They are not live recordings, do not verify provider access, and contain no real
credentials, customer data or screenshots. The token markers used by tests are
non-working placeholders. Both live gates remain open. TikTok purchase value and
Meta v25+ attention-field availability still require the owner's live confirmation.
